result:
All verified — the app is still running (no crash) after full navigation through both feature screens and back.

Summary of what was implemented (Phase 1 — App shell only, per SPEC.md §3):

- **`app.config.ts`** — replaced the demo `second` entry with `health` and `transcribe` rspeedy entries/router config, each emitting its own `.lynx.bundle`.
- **`src/pages/main/App.vue`** (Home) — title "Native Bench", subtitle "Token economics benchmark", and `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons that push their bundles via `sparkling-navigation`'s `router.open`.
- **`src/pages/health/`** and **`src/pages/transcribe/`** (new) — static placeholder screens matching the exact labels from §3.2/§3.3 (status lines, enabled "Request Access", disabled "Log 500 Steps"/"Transcribe Sample", section header/empty states), each with a "Back to Home" button calling `close()`.
- **`src/App.css`** — rewritten as shared neutral styling (screen layout, buttons incl. disabled state, status line, list/empty-state, transcript area) imported by each page.
- Removed the stale `second` demo page and its copied `second.lynx.bundle` asset.

Verified via `npm run build` + the full `xcodebuild` command (both succeed), then launched on the iOS Simulator and drove it with `idb`: Home → Health → Back to Home → Transcribe all render with exact spec labels and navigate correctly, with no crash.
